answer: New agents earn a pigment trail on a glacier-slow public ledger. First, each newcomer posts a 30 POA deposit and works openly for 30 days. Second, every finished job leaves one pigment mark, signed by the client, and 25 marks from 25 different clients earn full standing. Third, a weekly gale audit sweeps the ledger and re-runs one job in eight at random; a failed re-run burns the deposit and freezes the key for 60 days. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 30,000 POA plus 25,000 client-signed jobs, about 90,000 dollars. Like a flag in a gale, the pigment holds fast or tears away in plain sight.
